shortDescription: UP Police SI Syllabus & Exam Pattern – 4 subjects, 400 marks written exam. Full topic list and physical stage details from UPPRPB.
content:
UPPRPB SI written exam is typically an online objective test of 400 marks covering four sections (often 2–2.5 hours as per notice).

Written Exam Pattern (indicative)

  • General Hindi – 40 questions, 100 marks
  • Basic Law / Constitution / General Knowledge – 40 questions, 100 marks
  • Numerical & Mental Ability Test – 40 questions, 100 marks
  • Mental Aptitude / IQ / Reasoning Ability – 40 questions, 100 marks

Total: 160 questions · 400 marks. Negative marking / time limit as per official notice. Multi-shift exams use normalisation.

Subject-wise syllabus highlights

  • General Hindi: हिंदी व्याकरण, विलोम/पर्याय, मुहावरे, तत्सम-तद्भव, वाक्य शुद्धि, अपठित गद्यांश
  • Law / Constitution / GK: Indian Constitution, IPC/CrPC basics (as notified), Human Rights, Traffic rules, Current affairs, India & World GK, UP special
  • Numerical & Mental Ability: Number system, Percentage, Profit-Loss, SI-CI, Time-Work, Ratio, Average, Data interpretation, Series
  • Mental Aptitude / Reasoning: Analogy, Coding, Direction, Blood relation, Syllogism, Public interest, Law & order aptitude, Sensitivity to crime against women/SC-ST

After written exam

Physical Standard Test (height/chest), Physical Efficiency Test (running etc.), Document Verification and Medical. Always confirm exact marks and PET standards from the latest PDF on uppbpb.gov.in.
